hypothesis: Request232 ranking is useful but Requests233-234 show that a global economic zero boundary is unstable. Conditioning the frozen Request232 scores on strictly prior same-day first-HOT market context may recover a transferable positive admission boundary.
frozen: Request232 tradability target, ranking learner and probability p75 gate

market_context.source: strictly earlier first-HOT episodes on the same day
features: prior HOT mean return from previous close
prior HOT mean minute body return
prior HOT mean second realized volatility

calibrator.inputs: frozen Request232 regression score, frozen Request232 positive probability, and causal market context
calibrator.calibration_check: leave-one-calibration-day-out across all eight calibration days
calibrator.row_weight: equal total weight per training day
calibrator.admission: frozen Request232 p75 AND market-conditioned expected persistent value > 0

forbidden: future same-day HOT observations in market context
June fresh outcomes in fitting or threshold selection
adding downstream timing before economic admission is stable
next_if_pass: Freeze market-conditioned economic admission and train a new causal ENTER-vs-WAIT controller only inside admitted episodes; repair target coverage separately.
next_if_fail_calibration: Current Request232 representation cannot support a stable positive economic boundary even with causal market context. Revisit tradability target/representation rather than stacking more admission gates.
next_if_fail_fresh: Market-conditioned boundary is development-stable but not June-stable. Inspect regime transport before timing.
